text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin wins the spring Tenno<n>Sho, snatching
victory from the<n>clutches of the prestigious
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But while she celebrates her win,<n>Mejiro Ryan
faces her fans and,<n>even after her loss, makes a
rousing<n>declaration that reinvigorates both<n>them and
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines watches closely. Sensing that<n>Mejiro Ryan is
on another level from<n>her, she begins to seriously
consider<n>the way she engages with her<n>supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In part to determine whether she has<n>what it takes
to reach Ryan's level,<n>Ines decides to throw herself
into<n>training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
